MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

2. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 5
   C. 8
   D. 16

3. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 9

4. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

6. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.025

7. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 3
   C. 15
   D. 17

10. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 36

12. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 24

13. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

14. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

15. Solve for x: x + 8 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 17
   C. 9
   D. 10

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 55
   C. 32
   D. 16

17. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/2

18. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 57
   C. 15
   D. 56

19. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

20. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

21. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 170

22. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 30
   C. 40
   D. 75

23. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 5

24. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 13
   C. 5
   D. 36
